title: Kit of Parts
style: A design asset from a high-end design asset library, shown alone, crisp, modern and minimal, made with flawless quality. A 3D object sits perfectly centred on a clean flat studio background in one solid colour that fills the whole frame from edge to edge, with a soft natural shadow. A poster or a surface is flat digital artwork that fills the whole frame from edge to edge, seen perfectly straight on, with nothing around it. Portrait 4:5. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, captions, labels or brand names anywhere except the exact words given. No mockup, no device, no hands, no people, no logos, no watermark, no border, no margin, no frame.

items.title: Chrome Blob
items.text: A liquid metal shape that reflects whatever it sits on.
items.prompt: A smooth liquid chrome blob sculpture with soft rounded lobes, mirror-polished, reflecting a soft studio, on a pale lilac background.

items.title: Glass Prism
items.text: Clear glass that throws a rainbow across the floor.
items.prompt: A clear glass triangular prism standing on its end, casting a sharp rainbow caustic across the floor, on a warm off-white background.

items.title: Clay Arch
items.text: A soft arch in matte terracotta.
items.prompt: A smooth chunky terracotta clay arch, matte with a fine texture, a soft shadow beneath, on a sand-coloured background.

items.title: Inflated Heart
items.text: A puffy vinyl heart, blown up like a balloon.
items.prompt: An inflated glossy pink vinyl heart, puffy like a balloon with soft seams and highlights, floating slightly above a bright red background with a soft shadow.

items.title: Rubber Knot
items.text: A thick tube tied in one tight knot.
items.prompt: A thick tube of glossy cobalt-blue rubber tied in one tight knot, on a pale sky-blue background with a soft shadow.

items.title: Pearl Stack
items.text: Five pearls of falling size, balanced.
items.prompt: A stack of five iridescent pearl spheres of decreasing size balanced on top of each other, soft pink and silver sheen, on a soft warm grey background.

items.title: Frosted Ring
items.text: A frosted glass ring with light trapped inside.
items.prompt: A thick frosted glass torus ring standing upright, glowing with orange and hot pink light from inside, on a pure black background.

items.title: Chrome Star
items.text: A four-pointed star, puffed up and polished.
items.prompt: A puffy inflated chrome four-pointed star, mirror-polished and soft-edged, on an acid yellow background with a soft shadow.

items.title: Push
items.text: One word, pushed as tall as the page allows.
items.prompt: A typographic poster with the single word PUSH in huge ultra-condensed heavy black capitals filling almost the whole frame, on an acid lime green background.

items.title: Soft
items.text: Letters inflated until they almost touch.
items.prompt: A typographic poster with the single word Soft in a huge, rounded, puffy inflated bold typeface in white with soft 3D shading, on a lilac background.

items.title: Loop
items.text: Outlined capitals with nothing inside but colour.
items.prompt: Flat typographic artwork, full-bleed, filling the whole image: the word LOOP spelled correctly in four clean separate letters, huge outlined geometric capitals with thick black outlines and no fill, running almost to every edge, on a flat bright orange that covers the whole image.

items.title: Form
items.text: An elegant serif at the size of a building.
items.prompt: Flat typographic artwork, full-bleed: the entire image is one flat warm cream colour reaching all four edges, with the single word Form set across it in huge elegant high-contrast serif black type spanning almost the full width. Not a sheet of paper, not a poster on a wall, no grey surround.

items.title: Echo
items.text: The same word five times, fading out.
items.prompt: Flat typographic poster artwork that fills the whole frame edge to edge, not a printed poster on a wall: the word ECHO repeated five times in a tight stack in heavy grotesque capitals as wide as the frame, fading from solid black at the top to pale grey at the bottom, on flat white that covers the whole frame.

items.title: Yes
items.text: A loud yes in red.
items.prompt: Flat typographic poster artwork that fills the whole frame edge to edge, not a printed poster on a wall: the single word YES in huge heavy rounded capitals in bright red, running almost to every edge, on a flat pale pink that covers the whole frame.

items.title: Hold
items.text: White italic on black, leaning forward.
items.prompt: Flat typographic poster artwork that fills the whole frame edge to edge, not a printed poster on a wall: the single word Hold in a huge bold italic sans-serif in white, running almost to the left and right edges, on flat deep black that covers the whole frame.

items.title: Holo Foil
items.text: Crumpled foil throwing every colour back.
items.prompt: A close-up of softly crumpled holographic foil with rainbow reflections of cyan, pink and gold. The foil fills the whole frame and runs past every edge, with no background, no sheet edges and no shadow visible.

items.title: Riso Gradient
items.text: Hot pink to blue, printed with grain.
items.prompt: A risograph print of a smooth gradient from hot pink at the top to bright blue at the bottom, with visible grain and halftone dots, filling the whole frame edge to edge.

items.title: Terrazzo
items.text: Big chips of colour set in white.
items.prompt: A terrazzo surface seen straight on, big chips of red, cobalt blue, mustard and cream set in white stone, filling the whole frame edge to edge.

items.title: Aurora Mesh
items.text: Soft fields of blue, violet and orange.
items.prompt: Abstract wallpaper, full-bleed: the entire image is a smooth mesh gradient of deep blue, violet and glowing orange fields melting into each other like an aurora. The colours reach all four edges of the image; there is no white and no paper anywhere, no frame, no print, no object.

items.title: Reeded Glass
items.text: A gradient split into bands by fluted glass.
items.prompt: Vertical fluted reeded glass seen straight on, close up, in front of a bright orange and pink gradient, refracting it into soft vertical bands. The glass fills the whole frame and runs past every edge, with no frame, no white margin and no text.
